News
====

0.1.1 (2003-11-24)
------------------

New features:

- *bot2vrml.py*: Make component link base configurable through the -c command 
  line switch, as the default (``..\Components\``) doesn't make much sense.

Bug fixes:

- *RA2Bot*: Fix component link generation in bot VRML exports (missing .wrl 
  extension)
  
- *bot2vrml.py*: Save snapshots in the same directory as the export.


0.1.0 (2003-11-18)
------------------

Initial release to the public.
